---
name: Stigmatus Covenant Epic Tournament Special Rules
---
<dl>
  <dt>Arch-Heretic</dt>
  <dd>Every Stigmatus Covenant Chaos Cultist army must include an Arch-Heretic character. The Arch-Heretic character is free, you don’t have to pay any points for it, and may be added to any Daemon Prince, Demagogue or Chaos Marine Aspiring Champion unit.</dd>

  <dt>Formation Allegiance</dt>
  <dd>Each formation in a Stigmatus Covenant Chaos Cultist army owes allegiance to Chaos Undivided or one of the four chaos gods: Khorne, Nurgle, Slaanesh or Tzeentch. The player must declare each formation’s allegiance before the battle, noting it down on their army list.</dd>

  <dt>Plague Zombies</dt>
  <dd>Plague Zombie Infestation formations must be deployed via <em>teleport</em>. After placing the first unit roll 3+2D6 to see how many units are in the formation. Plague Zombie Infestation formations may contest, but not control, objectives.</dd>

  <dt>Summoning Point Costs</dt>
  <dd>The summoning point costs for a Stigmatus Covenant Chaos Cultist army are below. If a row contains a point cost in parentheses than this is the cost for formations that owe allegiance to Chaos Undivided.</dd>
